kokoro.download: about 330 MB, cached in the browser
kokoro.license: base model Apache-2.0; pinyin-pro and onnxruntime-web MIT
kokoro.g2p: local pinyin-pro Zhuyin tokens with a simplified third-tone sandhi pass

zipvoice.runtime: sherpa-onnx WASM from the k2-fsa static Space
zipvoice.download: about 200 MB, cached by the browser/HTTP cache
zipvoice.clone_input: 3-10 second reference audio plus its exact transcript
zipvoice.storage: reference audio and transcript in local IndexedDB only

piper.change: warmth filter (85 Hz high-pass, -4 dB presence cut, -7 dB high shelf, 8.5 kHz low-pass) before RMS normalisation
piper.purpose: reduce the piercing high-frequency edge of the experimental zs-v1 weights
piper.limit: comfort fix, not a model upgrade

unit.command: node --test tests/reader-v03/core.test.mjs tests/reader-v03/pacing.test.mjs tests/reader-v03/voice-library.test.mjs tests/reader-v03/library.test.mjs tests/reader-v03/piper.test.mjs

browser_public.excluded: self-hosted family voice library section (https page cannot call loopback)

known_gaps: Kokoro uses a 330 MB fp32 ONNX export; the same model's int8 export produced unintelligible audio in onnxruntime-web WASM
only 9 of Kokoro's 100 Chinese voices are exposed in the UI
Kokoro G2P is pinyin-pro plus simplified tone sandhi, not the full misaki jieba/POS frontend; some polyphones may still be wrong
ZipVoice weights are CC-BY-NC and non-commercial; generation is slower than Piper and not streaming
ZipVoice requires a 3-10 second reference clip and its exact transcript
ZipVoice runtime/model files are fetched from the k2-fsa static Space; it is an external dependency
real-device speaker, Bluetooth, iOS Safari, lock-screen playback and audio focus are not yet accepted
broadcast-quality emotional cloning still needs a self-hosted GPU model such as IndexTTS-2.5 or CosyVoice 3; not part of this increment
